analysis: Both blind readings match the key on ruling, amount, compensation, referrals and difficulty; the only differences are a harmless extra POL-NS-02 in both readers' clause lists and a fix-count slip in reader A. Worked independently from the version-6 text: the record carries platform_policy (AUTHORED-V1), so fee_schedule.resolution_rule takes cancellation_fee_sgd 8.00 and free_wait_sec 300 from EV-TRIP-04065 (minimum_dwell_sec is never applied to a record carrying platform_policy; the default 180 s would give the same result). The fare line 8.00 reconciles with the net figure, so no POL-NS-08(d) defect. POL-NS-02: zone TRANSPORT_HUB, radius 150 m; 11 consecutive fixes 18:12:30-18:14:05 inside it at accuracy 4.6-9.8 m, first qualifying fix 18:12:30 (76.3 m), so arrival is established. POL-NS-05: the 18:12:50 tap coincides with a fix at 19.1 m and 0 km/h, so the marker is not false and no referral arises; POL-NS-12 does not apply (arrival_marker BUTTON). POL-NS-01(c): dwell from 18:12:30 to the 18:14:05 driver cancellation = 95 s < 300 s, so limb (c) fails and the fee is not chargeable. POL-NS-06: effective dwell 95 s < 300 s, refund in full whether or not the rider was present; limb (i) cannot help (one continuous interval, and EV-ADVIS-04065-01 is MISSING), and limb (ii) bars any advisory or peak-hour excuse. Refund = 8.00 = amount_contested_sgd, FULL_REFUND 8.00, no compensation, no referrals. Other clauses: POL-NS-03 no (driver inside the radius); POL-NS-04 does not apply (MSG-04065-005 answered in 25 s; rider fixes all > 200 m on admissible accuracy) but is not needed; POL-NS-10 no (driver termination, no waiting-time line); POL-NS-11 no (rider_track present); POL-NS-07/09 not reached, and counters are clean anyway (no_show_terminations_30d 1 of 150; rider no_show_disputes_30d 0; counterparty disputes 0 + 0). POL-NS-08: no skew (tap and cancellation coincide with fixes), max gap 10 s, chat 7/7 sequential with a 210 s interval over the arrival marker, fare reconciles; no limb engaged. Confidence cap 1.0 (POL-GEN-02). There is no second defensible answer: the shortfall is 205 s on clean evidence and survives every alternative clock (75 s from the tap, 180 s default). Key right; no case change needed.
